draft.title: Units and precision
card: Convert units by multiplying or dividing. 1 m = 100 cm = 1000 mm, and 1 km = 1000 m. For area, square the factor: 1 m² = 10 000 cm². For volume, cube it: 1 m³ = 1 000 000 cm³.
Capacity is how much a container holds. 1 L = 1000 mL, and 1 L = 1000 cm³. So 1 mL = 1 cm³.
Scientific notation writes a number as a × 10ⁿ, with a from 1 up to (but not including) 10. So 45 000 = 4.5 × 10⁴ and 0.0032 = 3.2 × 10⁻³.
Significant figures start at the first non-zero digit. 0.004 07 has 3 significant figures. To round, look at the next digit: 5 or more rounds up. So 0.004 07 to 2 significant figures is 0.0041.
draft.remember: Square the factor for area, cube it for volume. Count significant figures from the first non-zero digit.

a.q: What is 3 m² written in cm²?
a.why: 1 m = 100 cm, so 1 m² = 100 × 100 = 10 000 cm². Then 3 × 10 000 = 30 000 cm². Using 100 instead of 10 000 gives 300, which is the length factor, not the area factor.

b.q: A tank holds 2.5 m³ of water. How many litres is this?
b.why: 1 m³ = 1 000 000 cm³, and 1000 cm³ = 1 L, so 1 m³ = 1000 L. Then 2.5 × 1000 = 2500 L. Choosing 2 500 000 stops at cm³ and does not convert to litres.
b.clue: Change m³ to cm³ first, then use 1 L = 1000 cm³.
